## Code Review: PR #9 - `conversionDropped` / Status Visibility - PARTIALLY ADDRESSED File: src/components/ContributionStatsPage.tsx:542-546 ```tsx {conversionVisible && convertDropped > 0 && (

{t('conversionDropped', { count: convertDropped })}

)} ``` ⚠️ **PARTIALLY ADDRESSED**: The PR response states "When visible and dropped > 0, the dropped message renders; when 0 there is nothing to report. Status is never hidden incorrectly." **However**, the original review requested: "Show status always when `conversionVisible`, regardless of `convertDropped` value, so user always knows conversion state." **Current behavior**: - `conversionUnavailable` shows when `conversionBlocked` (lines 536-540) ✅ - `conversionDropped` only renders when `convertDropped > 0` ❌ - When conversion succeeds (`convertDropped === 0`), **no status message appears** — silent success **Expected**: User should always know the conversion state when `conversionVisible` is true. At minimum, show "All transactions converted successfully" or similar when `convertDropped === 0` to confirm the view is fully accurate. **Suggested fix**: Add an `else` branch or separate condition to show success state: ```tsx {conversionVisible && ( convertDropped > 0 ? (

{t('conversionDropped', { count: convertDropped })}

) : (

{t('conversionComplete')}

) )} ``` — produced by agent · model openrouter/nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning:free
